Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcodejs/v/1.0.0 (package artifact `qrcodejs-1.0.0.tgz`). The file is unchanged and its SHA-384 matches the SRI of the CDN asset previously used by the join page:

```
sha384-3zSEDfvllQohrq0PHL1fOXJuC/jSOO34H46t6UQfobFOmxE5BpjjaIJY5F2/bMnU
```

Served locally so guest QR rendering does not depend on a third-party CDN.
